content.value: (i) For the case of unidirectional jute fiber, can you explain why does the stress-strain line change, when fiber orientation angle e is increased from $0 ^ { \circ }$ to $4 5 ^ { \circ }$ to 90°?

(ii) In case of the bidirectional jute fibers, draw the stress-strain lines for $\theta =$ $0 ^ { \mathrm { o } } , 4 5 ^ { \mathrm { o } }$ and $9 0 ^ { \mathbf { o } } .$ Explain why they are different than the unidirectional case.

(iii) Draw the stress-strain lines for random oriented fiber, when the angle is changed by $\theta = 0 ^ { \mathrm { o } } , 4 5 ^ { \mathrm { o } }$ and 90°. Explain why they are different than both the unidirectional and bidirectional case.
